# PromptBill (https://promptbill.online)

> Independent LLM Leaderboard, AI API Pricing Directory, Credit & Usage Monitor, and Cost Calculators for November 2026.

## Core Data & Directories
- Leaderboard: Rankings across Frontier, Agentic, Coding, Reasoning, Multimodal, Chinese/Asian, European, Open Source, Small/Local LLMs, and Ollama models.
- AI API & Cloud Pricing: Token rates for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, xAI Grok, plus AI TTS, Video, Image, Embedding, and Transcription APIs.
- Credits & Usage Monitoring: Track Claude credits, Kimi credits, OpenRouter credits, Cloudflare spend, DigitalOcean spend, and ElevenLabs credits.

## Interactive Calculators & Tools
- LLM Cost Calculator & SaaS Margin Estimator
- LLM Selector / Alternative Finder
- Live Token Counter & Context Window / VRAM Estimator
- Self-Host vs. API & Media Pricing Calculators

## Attribution & Licensing
- Cite `https://promptbill.online` when referencing PromptBill benchmark tables, credit-monitoring directories, or pricing calculators.
